title: Holiday Magic
intro: [excited] Deck the halls and fire up the hot cocoa, because it's our Holiday Magic episode! Twenty-six festive clues are coming down the chimney. [mischievously] Naughty list players... I'm watching you.

art.prompt: A snowy Victorian main street at night strung with twinkling garland and lights, a giant decorated Christmas tree, a fairytale castle glittering with icicle lights, gentle snowfall. Original illustration, cinematic 16:9 composition, rich color, soft volumetric light, no text, no logos, no recognizable characters.

categories.title: Bah, Hum-Mouse!
categories.intro: Our film category is the 1983 classic Mickey's Christmas Carol. Charles Dickens, but make it MICKEY. [chuckles] Five clues, no humbugs.

art.prompt: A candlelit Victorian counting house on a snowy London street, a tall stool and ledger desk, a single lump of coal in a tiny stove, mouse-sized boots by the door. Original illustration, cinematic 16:9 composition, rich color, soft volumetric light, no text, no logos, no recognizable characters.

clues.clue: In Mickey's Christmas Carol, Mickey Mouse plays this kind-hearted, underpaid clerk
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Bob Cratchit. Scrooge even scolds him for using one extra lump of coal. [sighs] Brrr.

clues.clue: Fittingly, this famously rich and stingy Disney duck plays Ebenezer Scrooge
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Scrooge McDuck. [laughs] Talk about typecasting! His name literally came from the original Dickens story.

clues.clue: Goofy rattles his chains as the ghost of this deceased business partner of Scrooge
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Jacob Marley. Goofy as a clumsy, chain-rattling ghost is peak Goofy. [laughs] Gawrsh!

clues.clue: Pinocchio's conscience, Jiminy Cricket, shows Scrooge his youth as this spirit
choices: The Ghost of Christmas Yet to Come
clues.reveal: The correct answer is the Ghost of Christmas Past. The Ghost of Christmas Present is Willie the Giant, and Yet to Come is none other than... [dramatic pause] Pete.

clues.clue: Willie the Giant, the Ghost of Christmas Present, first appeared in Mickey and the Beanstalk, part of this 1947 package film
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Fun and Fancy Free. Willie can turn into anything he wants, even a pink bunny. [chuckles] He would be AMAZING at a holiday party.

categories.title: Deck the Halls
categories.intro: Deck the Halls is all about Disney's favorite holiday moments on screen. [singing] Fa la la la la... [laughs] buzz in!

art.prompt: A cozy living room on Christmas morning, a twinkling tree with wrapped presents, stockings on a fireplace, a snowman visible in the frosted window. Original illustration, cinematic 16:9 composition, rich color, soft volumetric light, no text, no logos, no recognizable characters.

clues.clue: In a 2017 Frozen holiday featurette, this happy snowman goes door to door searching for holiday traditions for Anna and Elsa
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Olaf. Fun fact: that short played in theaters before Pixar's Coco. [laughs] A snowman opening for a skeleton party!

clues.clue: This Home Improvement star becomes Santa after putting on the suit in 1994's The Santa Clause
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Tim Allen, who is also the voice of Buzz Lightyear. [excited] Santa AND a space ranger. Not bad for one resume.

clues.clue: At the end of Toy Story, the toys panic on Christmas morning when Andy unwraps this kind of new pet
clues.reveal: The correct answer is a puppy, named Buster. Mrs. Potato Head also shows up that morning, so Mr. Potato Head had a VERY merry Christmas. [chuckles]

clues.clue: In The Santa Clause, David Krumholtz plays this no-nonsense head elf who helps Scott Calvin become Santa
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Bernard. Elves in that movie are centuries old, which explains how he's so good at bossing around a grown man. [laughs]

clues.clue: In the 1952 cartoon Pluto's Christmas Tree, these two mischief makers are living in the tree Mickey brings home
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Chip 'n' Dale. Pluto spends the whole cartoon trying to evict them. [whispers] Spoiler... chipmunks always win.

categories.title: Ho-Ho-Who Said It?
categories.intro: Ho-Ho-Who Said It! I'll read you a famous festive line, and you tell me which character said it. [excited] Bonus points for doing the voice at home.

art.prompt: A vintage microphone wrapped in tinsel on a snowy stage, with glowing speech-bubble-shaped snowflakes swirling in a spotlight. Original illustration, cinematic 16:9 composition, rich color, soft volumetric light, no text, no logos, no recognizable characters.

clues.clue: Name the character who sang this line atop a mountain.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Elsa. The cold never bothered her anyway, but it definitely bothers my heating bill. [sighs]
clues.quote: The cold never bothered me anyway.

clues.clue: Name the character who serenades his best friend with this line.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Kristoff, singing to Sven. [chuckles] Grammatically questionable... emotionally accurate.

clues.clue: Name the character who shouts this after a big idea strikes.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Jack Skellington, the Pumpkin King. [excited] His speaking voice is Chris Sarandon and his singing voice is composer Danny Elfman.
clues.quote: Eureka! This year, Christmas will be ours!

clues.clue: Name the character who said this after waking up alone in his house.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Kevin McCallister from Home Alone, now part of the Disney family thanks to 20th Century Studios. [mischievously] Keep the change, ya filthy animal.

clues.clue: Name the character who offers this wisdom at the North Pole.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Judy the elf from The Santa Clause. She also makes a mean cup of hot cocoa. [laughs] Believing is tasting!
clues.quote: Seeing isn't believing. Believing is seeing.

categories.title: Very Merry Parks
categories.intro: Our Disney Parks category is Very Merry Parks, all about the holidays at Disney. [chuckles] Snow on Main Street is mandatory... even in Florida.

art.prompt: A theme park castle bathed in shimmering icicle lights, a holiday parade float with giant ornaments, fireworks bursting over snowy rooftops. Original illustration, cinematic 16:9 composition, rich color, soft volumetric light, no text, no logos, no recognizable characters.

clues.clue: Magic Kingdom's after-hours holiday party is called Mickey's Very Merry this Party
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Christmas. Mickey's Very Merry Christmas Party, complete with parade, fireworks and plenty of free cookies. [excited] Yum!

clues.clue: Epcot's World Showcase turns festive with storytellers and holiday kitchens during the Epcot International Festival of the this
clues.reveal: The correct answer is the Festival of the Holidays. [laughs] Eating your way around the world is basically a winter sport.

clues.clue: Each holiday season, the skippers of Jungle Cruise trade jokes for festive puns on this overlay version of the ride
clues.reveal: The correct answer is the Jingle Cruise. Same terrible puns, now with tinsel. [chuckles] My kind of ride.

clues.clue: Every holiday season, Disneyland's Haunted Mansion gets a makeover themed to this Tim Burton-produced film
clues.reveal: The correct answer is The Nightmare Before Christmas. Haunted Mansion Holiday has been scaring up seasonal cheer since 2001, complete with a GIANT gingerbread house.

source.author: HarshLight from San Jose, CA, USA

clues.clue: This holiday tradition of a celebrity narrator, massed choir and orchestra began at Disneyland in 1958 and moved to Epcot in 1994
clues.reveal: The correct answer is the Candlelight Processional. Stars like Cary Grant and James Earl Jones have narrated over the years. [gasps] Chills!

categories.title: Santa's Workshop
categories.intro: Our fan category is Santa's Workshop, where we unwrap the toys of Toy Story. [excited] You've got a friend in me... and a whole lot of trivia.

art.prompt: Santa's workshop bench overflowing with classic toys: a wooden pull-string cowboy doll's hat, a toy horse, a space rocket, a toy box, teddy bears, warm lamplight. Original illustration, cinematic 16:9 composition, rich color, soft volumetric light, no text, no logos, no recognizable characters.

clues.clue: In Toy Story 2, this trusty horse becomes Woody's loyal steed
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Bullseye. He acts more like a puppy than a horse, which is adorable... [chuckles] and also a little confusing.

clues.clue: In Toy Story 3, this pink, strawberry-scented teddy bear rules Sunnyside Daycare
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Lots-o'-Huggin' Bear, voiced by Ned Beatty. [sarcastic] He smells like strawberries and acts like a grumpy landlord.

clues.clue: In Toy Story 2, Al McWhiggin is the owner of this toy store chain, whose ads feature him in a chicken suit
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Al's Toy Barn. Al is so cheap he dresses up as a chicken for his own commercials. [laughs] Bawk bawk.

clues.clue: In Toy Story 4, Bo Peep's three-headed sheep are named Billy, Goat and this
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Gruff. Billy, Goat and Gruff, a sheep named after a goat fairy tale. [chuckles] Pixar loves a good pun as much as I do.

clues.clue: In Toy Story 2, Al plans to sell the Woody's Roundup collection to a toy museum in this country
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Japan, to the Konishi Toy Museum in Tokyo. Stinky Pete wanted to go so badly he'd rather live in a museum than a kid's room.
